llm_response.reason: Website employs multiple scam tactics: promises of zero fees and guaranteed security/returns, ambiguous or unverifiable company info, mismatched support email domain, no legitimate contact address, overhyped and unrealistic performance claims, heavy urgency/psychological messaging, and recent, anonymous domain registration with privacy protection. It mimics legitimate crypto exchanges but lacks concrete proof of regulatory operation or business existence, fulfilling several scam characteristics listed.
